name: Maritime New Zealand
story: Maritime NZ’s Research, Analysis and Intelligence (RAI) team used data and analysis to support harm prevention and regulatory decisions. Its 2023 board minutes name Bonita Cooper (then listed as Bonita Gestro), Rachel Butler and Matt Patterson as presenters describing the team’s work. The record documents an analytical contribution to maritime safety and oversight.

sources.label: Maritime NZ board minutes, 2023, released under the OIA
